literal_meaning: এই দিক - ওই দিক (this side - that side)
figurative_meaning_en: all around or from all directions
example_sentences_in_bangla: এদিক-ওদিক থেকে খবর আসছে যে বাজারে দাম বেড়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: News is coming from all sides that prices have risen in the market.
He is looking here and there for someone.
note: This idiom is widely used in spoken Bengali to indicate scattered or surrounding contexts.
